overview.text: The Southern Smooth Snake is a small, harmless snake of south-western Europe and north-western Africa.

identification.text: Brown, greyish or reddish with dark bars or spots. A dark U-shaped mark (or two long spots) on the back of the head, a dark streak from the eye to the corner of the mouth, and a dark band across the head between the eyes. The belly is yellowish or red with black marks. Its scales are smooth.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: Portugal, Spain, Gibraltar, southern France, Monaco and Italy, and Morocco, Algeria and Tunisia.

habitat.text: Forests, Mediterranean scrub, rocky places, pasture and plantations.

recognise.text: Dark streak from the eye to the corner of the mouth.
Dark band across the head between the eyes.
